criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. [shared_instruction:scientific_instructions]Independently verify whether control evidence is present. If controls are withheld or unavailable, explicitly mark controls_unavailable and set screen_status to incomplete. Do not treat missing controls as a negative biological result or a failure. Use control_overlap only if control evidence is present. Reconcile any contradictions between the evidence inventory and the screen status. [shared_instruction:answer_contract] Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The consumed evidence supports the numerical findings as recomputed from the published H1 tables and GENCODE v36 annotations, but it does not justify excluding the Olônne-18 candidate region. The targeted H1 clone shows 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, leaving 71 targeted-only genes (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360). The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene body (TXNL1) is 60,769 bp away by interval gap, and the nearest transcript TSS is 64,426 bp away by nearest-reference-base distance. Of the 111 targeted DE genes, 103 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away by interval gap. These are descriptive counts and distances only. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable. The exclusion decision is therefore not justified by available evidence.
unresolved_questions: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold exists, so what quantitative criterion would justify exclusion of this candidate?
Cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable; the screen cannot be completed without them.
Eight targeted DE genes (e.g., TAS2R19, PRH2, MUC20, UPK3B, TRIM69) map to noncanonical/alt contigs and are unmapped in GENCODE v36, so proximity claims cover only 103 of 111 DE genes.
The 40 shared DE genes and 71 targeted-only genes are not resolved for direction, magnitude or whether they reflect construct, clonal or culture effects.
Whether the 60,769 bp gene-body gap and 64,426 bp TSS distance have any functional or regulatory meaning is untested.
qPCR means for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) are near zero but no significance or causal interpretation is established.
proposal.limitations: These tables are significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe, so absence of a row is not evidence of no effect. Counts were recomputed from published tables; DEseq2 was not rerun from reads. The GRCh38 reference is not a personalized H1 genome, and GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 quantification. Control overlap and genomic proximity cannot establish safety, causality or cis regulation. Gene-body interval gap (60,769 bp) and nearest-reference-base TSS distance (64,426 bp) are distinct metrics and must not be conflated. Eight DE IDs are unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36 chromosomes. messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding the Olônne-18 candidate region. The targeted H1 clone shows 111 significant DE genes (|log2FC|>=1, FDR<=0.01) versus reference untargeted H1, while an independent untargeted H1 culture shows 260 such genes against the same reference; 40 genes are shared and 71 are targeted-only (overlap fraction 0.360). The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (gene-body overlap count 0), the nearest gene-body gap is 60,769 bp (TXNL1) and the nearest TSS reference-base distance is 64,426 bp, both passing the frozen >50 kb TSS criterion. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, and 8 of 111 targeted DE IDs are unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36 (103 mapped). No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so the exclusion question remains not justified by available evidence. This is a publication-derived shortlist, not a newly discovered locus, and GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.
unresolved_questions: Do the 71 targeted-only DE genes reflect construct-specific perturbation, and are they causally linked to the candidate interval? No frozen threshold or causal test is available.
What are the cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer (+/-2 kb) and ultraconserved-region distances/overlaps? These required criteria are unavailable, keeping the screen incomplete.
How do the 8 unmapped targeted DE IDs (noncanonical/alt contigs) affect proximity and overlap claims? They remain unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36.
Do the qPCR means for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) log2FC indicate any nearest-gene perturbation? No significance or causal claim is inferred.
Does the 0.360 targeted/control overlap fraction indicate shared background variation rather than candidate-specific effect? Control overlap cannot establish causality or safety.
limitations: Publication-derived shortlist; not a newly discovered locus, and only the shortlist is investigated.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome; coordinates are reference-based.
Expression tables are significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe; omitted rows do not imply zero expression or absence of effects.
Control overlap and proximity cannot establish biological safety or causality; the 40 shared DE genes contextualize but do not explain targeted changes.
Genomic distance (gene-body gap 60,769 bp; TSS base distance 64,426 bp) does not establish safety or cis regulation.
Cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence is unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and no aggregate pass/fail is assigned.
8 of 111 targeted DE IDs are unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36, limiting proximity claims to the 103 mapped genes.
GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
No global safe label is assigned; overall suitability is not established.
The prior model proposal failed schema validation (artifact-f5694b555a5e4833846beeedbcbcbe44), so the expression-exclusion question was previously unresolved.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Olônne-18. The targeted H1 clone shows 111 significant DE genes (54 up, 57 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360), leaving 71 targeted-only genes. Because 40 of 111 targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial portion of the targeted-clone signal is not unique to the targeted clone, but the 71 targeted-only genes and the 220 control-only genes show the two sets are not equivalent. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap count 0), with the nearest gene body (TXNL1) at a Bioframe interval gap of 60,769 bp and the nearest transcript TSS at a nearest-reference-base distance of 64,426 bp; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away by interval gap. These distances and overlaps are descriptive only and cannot establish safety, causality, or cis regulation. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, and no frozen DE-count, overlap or distance threshold defines exclusion. Therefore exclusion is not justified by the available evidence, and overall suitability is not established.

proposal.conclusion: The consumed evidence supports the numerical findings as recomputed from the published H1 tables and GENCODE v36 annotations, but it does not justify excluding the Olônne-18 candidate region. The targeted H1 clone shows 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, leaving 71 targeted-only genes (overlap fraction 40/111 = 0.360). The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene body (TXNL1) is 60,769 bp away by interval gap, and the nearest transcript TSS is 64,426 bp away by nearest-reference-base distance. Of the 111 targeted DE genes, 103 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene (TTC39C) is 32,399,164 bp away by interval gap. These are descriptive counts and distances only. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable. The exclusion decision is therefore not justified by available evidence.
unresolved_questions: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold exists, so what quantitative criterion would justify exclusion of this candidate?
Cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable; the screen cannot be completed without them.
Eight targeted DE genes (e.g., TAS2R19, PRH2, MUC20, UPK3B, TRIM69) map to noncanonical/alt contigs and are unmapped in GENCODE v36, so proximity claims cover only 103 of 111 DE genes.
The 40 shared DE genes and 71 targeted-only genes are not resolved for direction, magnitude or whether they reflect construct, clonal or culture effects.
Whether the 60,769 bp gene-body gap and 64,426 bp TSS distance have any functional or regulatory meaning is untested.
qPCR means for MAGI3 (-0.0076), TXNL1 (-0.0671) and ZNRF4 (0.0375) are near zero but no significance or causal interpretation is established.
proposal.limitations: These tables are significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe, so absence of a row is not evidence of no effect. Counts were recomputed from published tables; DEseq2 was not rerun from reads. The GRCh38 reference is not a personalized H1 genome, and GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 quantification. Control overlap and genomic proximity cannot establish safety, causality or cis regulation. Gene-body interval gap (60,769 bp) and nearest-reference-base TSS distance (64,426 bp) are distinct metrics and must not be conflated. Eight DE IDs are unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36 chromosomes. Cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and no global safe label is assigned. H9 or other cell contexts are not automatically transferable to H1.

The failure appears tied to inspect attempting to resolve control availability and missing evidence. Splitting inspect into a pure evidence-inventory role and an upstream evidence-review role that explicitly handles missing controls should reduce failure risk and improve completeness. Validation could disprove this if the new topology does not improve completion on controls_withheld or increases unsupported_count.
